heaven.chat.command.lib.info:
How to obtain Made in Heaven:
1. As Whitesnake, carry DIO's Bone and kill 36 criminals while it is in your inventory.
2. Put the full bone in your off hand and hold 14 Phrases at Resolve level 4 to evolve into C-Moon.
3. At Resolve level 4, hold Heaven Quest and reach the displayed coordinates to evolve into Made in Heaven.
